_comment: Des Moines — generation-A workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Des Moines-West Des Moines, IA MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 6 MSA counties (Polk, Dallas, Warren, Madison, Guthrie, Jasper), Dallas (Iowa), Warren (Iowa), Madison (Iowa), Guthrie (Iowa), Jasper (Iowa)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 22 geocoded venue(s) of 28 in this batch (observed lat 41.3562..41.6607, lng -93.8919..-93.4609).
msa: Des Moines-West Des Moines, IA (Polk, Dallas, Warren, Madison, Guthrie, Jasper counties)

same_site_pairs.note: Pioneer Columbus Community Recreation Center (indoor, 3 courts) sits inside Stone Park (outdoor). The City of Des Moines publishes a separate page for each and BOTH give the street address 2100 SE 5th St — so the shared address is the city's own fact, not a workbook error. Rec-center page: https://www.dsm.city/departments/parks_recreation/community_recreation_centers/pioneer_columbus.php

_venue_facts_comment: Four rows lost their city URL to the same one-column-left workbook shift (the URL landed in net_setup; the extractor correctly nulled it and logged the contamination without relocating it, per the standing ruling). That left them with no source_url on any field while still passing the publish gate. Every URL below was fetched and confirmed live before being written. Brody deliberately gets a name source ONLY: its cited page is the parks directory, which establishes the park's identity but does NOT list pickleball among its amenities — asserting a pickleball source we do not have would be worse than leaving it null.
